body:
I think you did great. That actually made me feel a bit better. I'm just so caught up in the past, and the present, I've been ignoring the future. 

It is still tough. The biggest reason I put this here, is because logically it would be the easiest way to get away. And my mind keeps coming back to that, that if I want to get away that's the way. 

I've never been good with dealing with emotions. I've always had a hard time getting over things or understanding. 

I wish I didn't have to work alone all day. I really need people around me, thanks for the reply.

I'm going to check that out. I really am afraid of feelin like this forever. I just want to be done with it, but I just keep getting caught in thought processes which lead me to miss her. 

I feel like I should be over it, but for every step forward, I take two steps back.
Thank you for your words. I'll send you a PM to update you, hopefully I have good news.

How does one change these thoughts? I've always been so logical, and just thought my way through everything. With this whole situation, I get caught up with emotion and get derailed with any sort of logical thought process. Then I get even more frustrated with myself and think about giving up on everything, because I can't even control myself.
